name: trash_emails
description: Move all emails from one or more senders to Trash. Uses Gmail batchModify — fast even for large volumes. Supports an optional extra_query to narrow scope (e.g. only trash messages before a date).

inputs.name: senders
inputs.description: List of sender identifiers whose messages should be trashed — can be email addresses (e.g. "noreply@ziprecruiter.com"), bare domains to match all senders at that domain (e.g. "quora.com"), or display names (e.g. "Cuts Clothing"). Wildcards like *@domain are accepted and normalized to the bare domain.

inputs.name: extra_query
inputs.description: Optional additional Gmail query clause combined with the sender filter, e.g. "before:2024/01/01" to limit to older mail.

inputs.name: max_per_sender
inputs.description: Messages trashed per sender per call. This tool always uses 1000 (hard cap).

outputs.description: Human-readable summary: total messages trashed and per-sender breakdown.
Total number of messages moved to Trash across all senders.

metadata.planner_description: Move emails from given sender/domain to Trash. Bulk.
